methodologyNotes: Roster covers twelve garden tillers/cultivators spanning small corded-electric cultivators (Sun Joe, Earthwise, WEN, Greenworks), gas mini-tillers (Honda, Mantis, Craftsman), and full-size gas front-/rear-tine tillers (Champion, Troy-Bilt, Southland, YARDMAX, Tazz), verified 2026-08-09 against manufacturer/official-brand pages (Sun Joe/shopjoe.com, Earthwise/American Lawn Mower Co., WEN Products, Champion Power Equipment, Troy-Bilt, YARDMAX) where reachable, corroborated by major retailers and dealers (Home Depot, Lowe's, Walmart, Cutlers, Ratingle) where the manufacturer's own site blocked automated access (Honda, Craftsman) or did not publish the figure at all. weight_lb, tine_count, and priceUsd are left null wherever no fetched source documented a figure, rather than inferring by analogy to similar models — null beats a guess. One adversarial correction was made to the seed list: "Champion 100251" is not a tiller — Champion Power Equipment's own site and operator's manual confirm model 100251 is a 25-Ton Full Beam Gas Log Splitter. The seed was replaced with Champion's actual current 22 in. 212cc front-tine garden tiller, model 100379 (championpowerequipment.com), which is the closest real Champion product to the category and specs implied by the seed. accessedAt 2026-08-09 throughout.

products.name: Sun Joe TJ604E 16 in. 13.5-Amp Electric Garden Tiller/Cultivator
products.priceNote: Current price at shopjoe.com (Sun Joe's official store), shown as 35% off an unstated regular price; Home Depot/Lowe's list the same SKU but their pages blocked automated access at check time.

specs.adjustable_tine_positions: No fixed-width tine adjustment; 3-position height-adjustable rear wheels control depth only

products.provenance: Sun Joe's own store page (shopjoe.com) confirms 13.5A motor at 370 RPM (±10%), 16 in. cultivating width, 8 in. depth, 6 steel blades, and 26.5 lb net weight. Home Depot and Lowe's list the identical TJ604E SKU with matching 16 in./13.5A copy but returned bot-blocked (403) responses on direct re-fetch, so they are cited as corroboration only. No tine-width adjustment is documented anywhere; only rear-wheel height (3 positions) is adjustable, which sets tilling depth, not width.

products.priceNote: Current price at americanlawnmower.com, the official site of American Lawn Mower Co. (Earthwise's parent brand). Other retailers (Lowe's, Amazon) list the same SKU but were not directly fetchable.

Lowe's listing independently confirms the forward-rotating, 13.5A, 16 in. spec under the "Forward-rotating Corded Electric Cultivator" title.

products.name: Champion Power Equipment 100379 22 in. 212cc 4-Stroke Front-Tine Tiller
products.priceNote: No price is published on Champion's own product page, and Home Depot's listing (304700089) blocked automated access; no other price could be verified from a directly fetched source.

specs.adjustable_tine_positions: Yes - 16 to 22 in. tilling width adjustment; depth gauge is also adjustable

products.provenance: CORRECTED FROM SEED: the seed model "Champion 100251" is not a tiller. Champion Power Equipment's own site and its hosted operator's manual (100251-om-english.pdf) confirm model 100251 is a 25-Ton Full Beam Gas Log Splitter, an unrelated product category. The seed was replaced with Champion's actual current front-tine garden tiller, model 100379, matching the seed's implied category and general size class. Champion's own product page confirms a 212cc 4-stroke engine, 16-22 in. adjustable tilling width (4 hardened-steel tines at 13.8 in. each), up to 8 in. tilling depth, dual forward/reverse tine rotation, and 119 lb weight; Home Depot lists the identical SKU under the same name. No price could be confirmed on either fetched source.
